propositions: CLI facade currently uses 19 overlapping frozensets and manual help resources, causing parser/help drift and incomplete command coverage
Twenty-one intercept-only commands lack canonical help and report as unknown to `rebar help` while handler `--help` is inconsistent
Runtime parsing and generated syntax must derive from one side-effect-free stdlib argparse factory shared between execution and build-time generation
Lazy route registry must defer handler/parser resolution and optional imports until after help display, preventing premature operation/config/mount composition
All visible canonical commands must appear once in grouped overview with byte-current generated package data before operation boundaries
Migration uses expand/contract per command family with parallel core/advanced parser migration and rollback via derived compatibility exports
